Maria: Kicking off the Sierra Systems joint bench sprint next week. Goal: evaluate perf/W, steady-state throughput, and kernel tune impact for our streaming workloads. Proposed window: Tue–Thu. Quick asks below.

Maria: Asks: 1) list of hardware images we get access to, 2) preferred kernel patch window, 3) telemetry schema & PII constraints, 4) acceptance criteria (p95 latency, watts/sample), 5) who owns marketplace listing copy.

Kevin (Sierra Systems): Thanks — we've got two lab units available (sierra-rack-01/02). Kernel team can reserve Wed/Thu for patching. Telemetry OK as long as we only ingest aggregated power and perf counters (no raw traces).

Anya: Do we have a canonical bench harness? I can run our baseline (redwood-bench v2) but need kernel + gcc versions and the quantized runtime build info. Also, will we be running int8 paths or FP16 baseline?

Maria: Plan is to run both FP16 (baseline) and int8 quantized path. I'll attach a minimal run command: ```
# minimal throughput run
./run_bench --model sierra-stream-1 --batch 1 --seq 2048 --mode throughput --profile power --iters 5000
```

Kevin (Sierra Systems): That command looks fine. We'll provide the kernel builds and asci logs. Also can share a lightweight telemetry contract (S3 link) — will that work for ingest?

Sam: For lab access — we need to provision a jumpbox and VPN creds. @Kevin, can you DM me the admin public key? I’ll open firewall rules for 10.12.0.0/16 for the test window.

Jess: Heads-up for communications: if we hit target perf/W numbers we'll want a co-announcement. Can we set a draft milestone: internal sign-off by Fri after the test window? Also need SOX/legal check for data redaction.

bench-bot: smoke-run completed on staging: 3 tests passed, basic power sampling OK. Logs: https://bench-logs.redwood.internal/1718502468/smoke

Anya: Small note — we should pin the kernel ABI matrix in the runbook to avoid noisy regressions. I'll add a matrix table to the runbook.

Maria: Great. I'll add the calendar invite and the runbook link: https://redwood.example/sierra-runbook. Action items: Maria -> finalize acceptance criteria, Kevin -> telemetry contract + kernel builds, Sam -> network + jumpbox, Anya -> bench matrix + baseline runs, Jess -> comms checklist. Ping here with any blockers. :rocket:
